title: Educational Support & Community Learning Initiative Across Underserved Wards
imageAlt: Educational Support & Community Learning Initiative Across Underserved Wards 2026
summary: Dr. Patience Ishaku Abbo reaffirmed her commitment to grassroots capacity building and educational excellence during the latest community outreach, providing learning materials and scholarship support for students.
body:
Dr. Patience Ishaku Abbo reaffirmed her commitment to grassroots capacity building and educational excellence during the latest community outreach, providing learning materials and scholarship support for students.

Addressing educators, parents, and community leaders, she emphasized that quality education remains the strongest foundation for community transformation.
